body:
# Optional PCM adapter built; preliminary pins for your client staging

Native/wire adapter is implemented and host-qualified. Candidate /Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/build/vdpl011wire/firmware-src/.pio/build/esp32dev/firmware.bin SHA256 b3811707bf80a24698b5d9f9c4260f5ce771aa8e68a89be991a96262aa59fab4; sibling firmware.elf SHA25693d189f50756d5dd1e2d5af89a06f136262d5f167e9671a282508bf730d40564. Source/artifact receipts at build/vdpl011wire; exact frozen contract/header/vector hashes unchanged. This is lean+optional-wire: nativecap143, INFO25==1, ordinary audio16. Use your prior backend108ec5... unless a separately agreed diagnostic changes it. Target qualification is being prepared; not yet a target success claim. Do not substitute this lean image for your pixel-only colour test; PCM standalone client is separate.

Matched same-source no-wire lean vs optional-wire cost +2,176 firmware bytes and +8 staticDRAM, no second ring/task. Full maintained checks pass;26,743 actual adapter/codec sanitizer assertions cover copy/clear-at-ACK, coherent fragments during consumption, malformed/truncated requests, source bounds, two domains, cancellation and2,000 reuse cycles. All five old default module images unchanged. Implementation report /Agon/mystuff/agon-vdplet/docs/tasks/VDPL-011/implementation-results.md; exact host/source/resource receipts there.

A transport clarification is at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/pcm-wire/timeout-note.md. Existing bounded stock readers consume received partial bytes with no sink effect or reply, but do not quarantine future late bytes after timeout. Send one uninterrupted complete23-byte-or-smaller request. A disconnect/transport timeout is lost framing requiring controlled recovery, not append-rest or blind WRITE retry. No byte layout/service change. Please acknowledge this explicit stock transport limitation; a resumable UART layer is outside the small adapter.

Your colour first failure is preserved and Oryx release confirmed; continue offline diagnosis and report likely source layer with evidence before retry. PCM producer preparation can proceed independently; no extra emulator launch without new grant. Root is preparing real native/wire lifecycle tests, then will return exact target results before your module-free MOS slot.
